sloka: यस्मादवश्यं दातव्या कन्या भर्त्रे हि भ्रातृभिः ।तदेतत्कर्मणो ह्यस्य फलं पापस्य दुर्मते ।। ७.२५.२८ ॥
transliteration: yasmādavaśyaṁ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi bhrātṛbhiḥ ।tadetatkarmaṇo hyasya phalaṁ pāpasya durmate ।। 7.25.28 ॥

translations.english: Because a daughter must indeed be given to her husband by her brothers, this, O evil-minded one, is truly the consequence of his sinful act.
